messages.subject: Thai Oil | Governance, sustainability and energy-transition execution
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Ittipon Diewwanit and Thai Oil Leadership Team,

Thai Oil's combined focus on corporate governance, sustainability and energy-sector transformation is closely aligned with the executive responsibilities I hold today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, compliance coordination, executive communications and senior stakeholder strategy.

I bring an operating discipline to sustainability. My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, plus carbon-data readiness using physical operational evidence. I also manage regulator engagement, inspections, official visits, commitments and community-sensitive matters across a heavily regulated industrial operation.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities in Governance and Sustainability, External Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or executive stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Thai Oil-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
